recent_news.title: 5 corruption gaps Congress must close in the Clarity Act
recent_news.summary: The most consequential crypto legislation in the world is moving forward in the U.S. Senate. As written, it leaves the United States exposed to money laundering, sanctions evasion, and conflicts of interest at the highest levels of government, argues Greytak.
